items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: George Williams never does play any, huh? ... George, George don't care much about playing funeral.

ctx.x: Well, I really don't know Mr. Russell. It's a hard thing to say. It's a hard thing to say.
So there's still two or three a month I think. Yeah. And then George Williams never does play any, huh?
Well, you see, I'll tell you. I don't know, but George, George don't care much about playing funeral.
